slides.title: HTML
slides.body:
The onclick Attribute
<button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="display('SECTION ID')">
  Go to Section 3
</button>
The onclick event occurs when the user clicks on an HTML Element
HTML
slides.notes: The JavaScript onclick function is designed to execute code when users interact with the HTML elements

slides.title: HTML onclick Attribute
slides.body:
Single/Double Quotes?
 onclick ="display('SECTION ID')">
slides.notes: The Attribute value which we provide to onclick should be enclosed in double quotes and the value inside the brackets of display() should be enclosed in single quotes

slides.title: CCBP UI Kit - Display Utility
slides.body:
Specifying unique id 
The id which we specify to any section should always contain its prefix as section*
section1
sectionAB
Section1 
section AB
slides.notes:
To use ccbp navigation utils you need to specify id with prefix screen-*

Section with capital letter and spaces are not allowed as id value
